config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Only for self-hosted deployments that set MCP_AUTH_TOKEN. The public hosted endpoint at canlii-mcp.vaquill.ai does not use it, so leave this blank. Format: 'Bearer <token>'.

config.label: Your CanLII API key
config.description: Your CanLII API key. Apply for one at https://www.canlii.org/en/feedback/feedback.html. Header-less clients can instead append ?token=<key> to the endpoint URL. The server never stores your key.
